welcome_lead: Today you'll feel the heat of Hungary 1956, Berlin 1961 and Cuba 1962.
meta_desc: GCSE History — Warsaw Pact, Hungary, Berlin Wall and Cuban Missile Crisis.

walkthroughs.body_html:
In 1955 the USSR formed the Warsaw Pact after West Germany joined NATO.

In October 1956 Hungarians overthrew their Stalinist regime. PM Imre Nagy announced free elections and withdrawal from the Pact. Khrushchev sent 200,000 troops and 1,000 tanks. Nagy was hanged in 1958.

Between 1949 and 1961, 2.7 million East Germans fled through West Berlin.

Overnight on 13 August 1961 the GDR built the Berlin Wall. Kennedy gave his 'Ich bin ein Berliner' speech in 1963. The Wall became the symbol of a divided world.

After Castro's revolution and the failed Bay of Pigs (April 1961), Khrushchev placed nuclear missiles in Cuba.

U-2 photos exposed them on 14 October 1962. Kennedy blockaded the island. After 13 days, Khrushchev removed the missiles in return for a secret US pledge to remove missiles from Turkey.

How was the Cuban Missile Crisis resolved?
options: The crisis ended when Castro persuaded Khrushchev to withdraw.
Kennedy stared Khrushchev down and the Soviets backed off unconditionally.
A secret deal: the USSR withdrew missiles from Cuba; the US publicly pledged not to invade Cuba and secretly agreed to remove Jupiter missiles from Turkey.
The Truman Doctrine ordered the dropping of the atomic bomb on Japan.
The crisis ended when Castro persuaded Khrushchev to withdraw.
It began when the USSR shot down a US spy plane.
Stalin started it by invading Eastern Europe after the war.
Ideological incompatibility plus mutual suspicion after WWII — disputes over Eastern Europe, the atomic bomb, and broken wartime agreements.

mcqs.q: What did the Truman Doctrine commit the US to in 1947?
options: It began when the USSR shot down a US spy plane.
Supporting free peoples resisting communist takeover — initially Greece and Turkey — formalising the policy of containment articulated by George Kennan.
The Truman Doctrine ordered the dropping of the atomic bomb on Japan.
The Truman Doctrine declared war on the Soviet Union.
